notes.title: Dev update #1
notes.content: [p]Another week, another development update! We've been busy squashing bugs and adding some exciting new features to the game. Let's dive into what's new:[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Visual & Immersion Improvements[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Vibrant Sunset/Sunrise Colors:[/b] We've tweaked the sun's colors to make those epic in-game sunrises and sunsets even more breathtaking. Get ready for some seriously stunning screenshots![/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother AI Movement:[/b] Ever notice our AI buddies (and enemies!) looking a little jerky when they turn? We've smoothed out their rotation speed for more natural and fluid movement.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Base Building & Decoration[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fairy Lights Decoration:[/b] Get ready to add some sparkle to your base! You can now craft and place [b]fairy lights[/b] to give your humble abode that cozy, magical glow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Buildable Walls with Building Minigame:[/b] Fortify your base like never before! Ever notice our AI buddies (and enemies!) looking a little jerky when they turn? We've smoothed out their rotation speed for more natural and fluid movement.
Get ready to add some sparkle to your base! You can now craft and place [b]fairy lights[/b] to give your humble abode that cozy, magical glow.
